items.title: Ronnie Zito interviewed by Monk Rowe & Rick Montalbano, via Zoom, March 9, 2022
items.q: And they had big names coming in, you know, Tony Bennett and Sammy Davis, all these people. And I didn’t play for every one. I mean you know most of the big guys had their own rhythm section you know, so I might sit out.

ctx.x: Oh yeah. Yeah. And Tony Riposo was the leader and he hired me and at the time I had not much experience playing for acts. And they had big names coming in, you know, Tony Bennett and Sammy Davis, all these people. And I didn’t play for every one. I mean you know most of the big guys had their own rhythm section you know, so I might sit out. But then there were other people that came in like the Mills Brothers, you know, the Maguire Sisters, Four Lads, I would play for them. And it was great experience. And Tony…
